verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for any locally run CLI or library, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The security policies (Open, Limited, Secure, Websafe) and policy.xml coder disabling are adjacent network and security hardening controls, not telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
